01 · The Opportunity

Nobody's built her
a wardrobe for tonight.

She has outgrown fast fashion and can't afford luxury. We can be first.

01

The gap

Fast fashion competes on price. Luxury stays out of reach. The one thing every woman actually shops for — what to wear for the night ahead — has no home of its own.

02

The insight

She isn't buying a top. She's buying who she gets to be tonight. Berlin techno and a Goa beach club call for two different women — today's platforms can't tell them apart.

03

The position

Accessible premium. Indian-born, globally fluent, unmistakably ours. Not traditional ethnic wear, not a Western festival brand in translation — a category of one, claimed first.

Inspired by Indian goddesses.

Live venue pins, sourced from the events database

08 · omY'S Club

You don't shop here.
You belong here.

Exclusive content

Behind the scenes, drop previews, artist collabs. Gated to members, made for them.

Early access

First look and first pick on limited genre drops before anyone else gets in.

A community, not a customer list

Party updates and a real stake in the world she's already living in.

What it needs to ship
  • Account authentication
  • Subscription billing, UPI-ready
  • Content gating by tier
  • A member-only surface, distinct from the shop

Recommended: launch after the shop and map are live. Membership earns its pull once there's a scene worth joining.

09 · Phased Roadmap

Sequence by what proves demand cheapest.

Phase 0

Foundation

Design system from the brand guidelines, the landing page, one genre world built start to finish.

Prove the walk-into-a-party feeling before repeating it four more times.

Phase 1

Shop Live

The remaining four genre worlds, full video product pages, cart and checkout live.

Get the commercial engine running and selling.

Phase 2

The Map

The database-backed club and event map, with a lightweight admin path.

The nightlife-authority hook. Drives repeat traffic between drops.

Phase 3

omY'S Club

Membership authentication, billing, and gated content.

Launch once there's a community worth paying to join.

10 · Decisions We Need From You

Five calls that gate the build.

1

Photoshoot timeline

When does supplied and stock imagery get replaced by the real video-led shoot?

2

Music licensing

Per-genre track sourcing and rights, ideally through DJ and artist relationships already on the roadmap.

3

Map data ownership

Who keeps the Bangalore club and event database current after launch?

4

Payments platform

Provider for checkout and omY'S Club recurring billing. UPI support is non-negotiable.

5

Build platform

Custom stack or headless commerce with a custom front end.
